title: Quaint & Cozy Guesthouse ~ Urban Farm ~ Music Row
description:
Enjoy the hustle and bustle of Nashville from the quiet guest house of our Urban Farm.  Our calm and tranquil guest house is nestled against our large garden, but still walkable to Vanderbilt, Music Row, Midtown, Belmount, 12 South and so much more.

The space
This guest house is small but has everything you need. It has a full kitchen stocked with necessities for cooking, a living space with big screen TV, bedroom, bathroom, and walk-in closet with laundry.  We allow 2 adults and up to 2 children (though we only supply 1 travel crib). 

The guest house is located behind our primary residence.  Enjoy the views of our large garden and our urban chickens.
